method: Complete bounded source reading of three pinned Kotlin files,1113 lines. Cross-read already credited Room entity/DAO and previously read SyncViewModel. Static behavior and lifecycle review only.
findings: Pinned header counts every Room row as offline pinned files although fileData nullable. Empty-state text more accurately says access paths disconnected, and preview explicitly tells user when content absent and PC disconnected. Therefore metadata pin is not complete offline-content guarantee.

PinnedFileEntity primary key only desktop path, with nullable Base64 fileData, no downloaded content URI, device identity, hash or generation. Download finalization in SyncViewModel stores metadata and at most small image/document preview, so a downloaded large file can be present in MediaStore yet not previewable via this offline hub; hub has no local URI fallback. Different paired desktops sharing a path can replace one row. Schema/source concern, no real databases inspected.

pinFile uses Room REPLACE with default null data, even for already pinned path, before requesting content again. Re-pinning can discard existing cache if fetch fails/disconnects. Previously reviewed content handler only writes fileData when null, so repeated successful request for existing cached content does not update cached bytes after desktop file change. No content-stamp verification.

Pinned preview whitelist includes md/code/svg/3gp/mov but getMimeTypeForExtension maps only smaller subset and defaults application/octet-stream. Locally cached md/rs etc choose binary preview, whereas connected server text MIME may render text. Cached MIME not persisted, so reconnect-independent renderer parity unproven.

Pinned full preview and save use shared fileContent without checking path against selected previewFile, mirroring search screen stale response risk. Compact sheet has hasContent path guard when no cached data; do not generalize missing check to compact branch.

Pinned list thumbnails use decode bounds/sample; compact image and ImageZoomView full Base64 decode have no explicit pixel cap or sampling and run in remember on composition. Base64 bytes also retained as String in Room/list and decoded copy. No memory/performance measurement.

ImageZoomView scale bounded1..5 but pan unbounded; scale/offset remembered without imageUrl key, so replacement retains transform. Base64 detection accepts ;base64 but extraction specifically base64,; invalid data falls back AsyncImage. Codec support/fallback including SVG unqualified without actual Android/Coil runtime.

PdfZoomView renders min(pageCount,15), but label denominator pages.size rather than actual pageCount and no truncation notice. A PDF with more than15 pages can appear complete at Page15of15. This is preview truncation, not PDF file loss.

PDF page dimensions multiplied2 and ARGB8888 allocations have no explicit dimension/pixel/aggregate byte guard.15-page count alone does not bound memory. Renderer/page/descriptor/tempfile cleanup occurs only success path, without use/finally; exception can leave resources/tempfile. No malformed/large PDF executed.

PDF input changes restart LaunchedEffect but loading/error/pages/zoom not reset at start. Successful next render does not clear previous error; existing error branch takes precedence over new pages. Synchronous render work inside IO has no explicit cancellation checks between pages; stale work/resource cleanup requires lifecycle testing.

Video preview duplicates search implementation: Handler callbacks removed on detach, no source explicit stopPlayback/tempfile deletion or AndroidView update for changed content. Decode/cache writes during composition. Runtime playback/resource outcome not proven.
Size formatter duplicates unclamped log1024 index against units endingTB; >=1024^5 out-of-range boundary. No Kotlin compiler available; no unchanged runtime control claimed.
candidate_requirements_for_library: Metadata/path identity must be distinct from content identity and offline availability.
Cached content must retain provenance and freshness stamp; same path on different sources is not identity.
Preview limits must be explicit and must not imply full document coverage.
Late async publication must match selected object and generation.
limits: No Android/Kotlin compilation, Compose/device/codec/PDF rendering, live requests or file actions executed.
No production-library changes or new runtime test claims. Global full repository count remains155/500.
